component.name: Zero Hour Reforged
component.summary: Command & Conquer Generals Zero Hour engine (needs your own copy of the game)
component.project_license: GPL-3.0-or-later AND LGPL-2.1-or-later AND GPL-2.0-or-later AND Zlib AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause AND MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND (Unlicense OR MIT-0) AND CC0-1.0 AND LicenseRef-LZH-Light

description.p: Zero Hour Reforged runs Command & Conquer Generals Zero Hour natively, from your own copy of the game (Steam, EA App, CD or The First Decade). No game files are included: on the first start it asks for your Zero Hour folder, and for the original Generals folder when that is not inside it.
